value.rationale: The signed microscopic measure is a recently formalized canonical metric invariant. A natural sharp extremal question over the two independent heights of a standard three-dimensional exposed-vertex family has a complete closed solution with a nontrivial geometric optimizer transition at \(n=5\), including an unattained boundary supremum for \(n=3,4\), a unique interior maximizer for \(n\ge5\), full weight formulas, and a limiting constant. This goes beyond a cheap local sign computation or another isolated counterexample; the optimizer-type change is structural and depends sharply on polygon size.
